STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give different descriptions of the DeepVariant output formats in the raredisease pipeline.
- The pipeline documentation states that DeepVariant reports its results in a standard VCF or gVCF file, and that the normalized VCF (<case_id>_snv.vcf.gz, with a .tbi index) is the file placed in the output folder by default [rare_output#h015].
- A team cheat-sheet note states that DeepVariant results are written only as a VCF file and that gVCF output is not available [fx_sr11_dv].
